# endpointcentral_patch_deployment_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a patch deployment policy (deployment window, reboot and notification settings) by exact name. The API can create policies but not update or delete them, so they are not a managed resource; create them in the console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "endpointcentral_patch_deployment_policy" "default" {
  name = "Deploy any time at the earliest"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact policy name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `platform` (String) `windows`, `mac` or `linux`.
- `system_created` (Boolean) Whether the policy is one ManageEngine ships.
